criteria.prompt: Does the device read as the hero with premium materials and clean reflections?
Is every on-screen word and UI element sharp and readable at delivery size?
Is the frame composed with a clear subject, deliberate framing and safe areas respected?
Is the subject lit clearly, exposed for any screen, with no haze or crushed detail?
Is the frame free of unlicensed third-party brands, logos and forbidden words?
Would this frame pass in a launch film from a top studio?
